## Play: Order Chain

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Order Chain (10 to 20 min)" icon="false"}
Run one stage of a helmet [supply chain]{.term} and place one order a week. Customer demand changes only once, yet orders swing more and more at each stage up the chain. This is the [bullwhip effect]{.term}. Afterwards, compare your team with the same weeks played with shared demand information.

{{< game order-chain title="Order Chain" height="820" >}}
:::
